subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: The e2e design doc shall carry the run cost of the suite it specifies as a reviewable property — the per-scenario cost class and cadence (FR-23) together with the harness section's stated per-run bound — so that the cost of the suite is judged at review time rather than discovered when it is built.
fit_criterion: on the dogfood and the fixtures, a reviewer can derive the cost of one scheduled run from the design doc alone; every scenario carries a cost class and a cadence and the harness section states its per-run bound; a doc from which the scheduled-run cost cannot be derived is a review finding
